maintenance.nextLiftMaintainTimeDesc: The maintenance trigger conditions are: the specified service time or running duration, whichever is reached first.

maintenance.runningDesc: The mobile actuator is composed of a driving motor, a steering mechanism, a wheel set and a corresponding controller. It receives electrical control instructions to achieve forward, backward, steering and speed regulation, ensuring the accuracy and stability of movement.
maintenance.sensorDesc: Driver/power/communication module and safety control, responsible for decision-making and execution; sensors include navigation, obstacle avoidance and operation assistance to realize environmental perception, and the two work together to ensure operation.

vision.goodsSpaceTips: For a single goods size, you can set the goods width and height, as well as the storage left and right gaps to adjust the parameters of the putting goods into space detection.

vision.pickAroundCompensation: Final picking front and back compensation
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips1: First, the pallet pose recognition will be performed, and the pallet pose will be adjusted, and the vehicle will be moved to the loading point after the pallet pose recognition, and the cross arm will be adjusted, and the car body will be adjusted in front and back, and the precise pallet will be placed.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips2: In the case of trucking, the compensation parameters on the left and right sides are different, and need to be adjusted separately. Generally, when loading on the left and right sides, the compensation parameters on the left and right sides should be exactly opposite.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips3: Loading must start from the front of the vehicle and load sequentially until the rear of the vehicle.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips4: Before loading, you need to fill in the width of the goods and the gap between the goods, assuming there are multiple pallets, fill in according to the maximum goods size.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips5: People look at the truck head, and use their left and right hands to distinguish the left and right side of the loading.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips6: Left side compensation: Left and right direction: To make the cross car approach the truck head direction, reduce the left and right compensation, otherwise to approach the truck head direction, increase the compensation. Front and back direction: To make the goods approach the surface of the carriage, reduce the front and back compensation, otherwise to make the goods approach the surface of the carriage, increase the compensation. To make the goods rotate counterclockwise, increase the angle compensation, otherwise reduce it.
vision.pickFlatWingLegendTips7: Right side compensation: Left and right direction: To make the cross car approach the truck car head direction, increase the left and right compensation, otherwise to approach the truck head direction, reduce the compensation. Front and back direction: To make the goods approach the carriage surface, reduce the front and back compensation, otherwise to make the goods away from the carriage surface, increase the front and back compensation. To make the goods rotate counterclockwise, increase the angle compensation, otherwise reduce.
vision.pickLegendTips1: Assuming that the pallets are biased in one direction each time, the left and right compensation parameters can be adjusted.
vision.pickLegendTips10: Assuming that each pick up is not in place (within about 50mm), the front and rear compensation parameters can be adjusted.
vision.pickLegendTips11: In the figure, the gap between the front surface of the tray and the root of the tooth is 50mm, you can fill in -40 in the front and rear compensation parameters, and the pick-up effect after the compensation is shown in the figure on the right, the vehicle will go 40mm more, and if the tray will be slapped in the actual process, the parameter will be increased.
vision.pickLegendTips12: Note that if the deviation between the front and rear pick-up is too large and exceeds 50mm, it is recommended to modify the distance parameter from the reference point to the front surface of the pallet after stopping.
vision.pickLegendTips2: In the following figure, the gap between the left and right sides is 50mm and 10mm respectively, then 20 can be filled in the left and right compensation parameters. The pickup effect after compensation is shown as the figure on the right, where the fork will enter the pallet from the center.
vision.pickLegendTips3: And the parameters should be reduced if the pallet are biased in the opposite direction.
vision.pickLegendTips4: Compensation rule: When the value increases, the AGV moves in the direction of the front.
vision.pickLegendTips5: Assuming that each pickup is not in place, the front and rear compensation parameters can be adjusted.
vision.pickLegendTips6: In the figure, the gap between the front surface of the tray and the root of the tooth is 50mm, you can fill in -40 in the front and rear compensation parameters, and the pick-up effect after compensation is shown in the figure on the right, and the wishbone will stretch out 40mm more.
vision.pickLegendTips7: When the value increases, the AGV moves in the direction of the front.The following picture shows the left side to pick up pallets.
vision.pickLegendTips8: Assuming that there is an angle between the  root of the fork and the bottom of the pallet every time the pallet been picked up, the angle compensation parameter can be modified.
vision.pickLegendTips9: If the angle is off by about 1° like the figure below, enter -1 in the Angle compensation parameter.Compensation rule: If the value increases, the AGV rotates counterclockwise.
vision.placeAroundCompensation: Final pallet front and back compensation
vision.placeShelfLegendTips1: Assuming that each time goods are placed on the shelf are turned in one direction, you can adjust the left or right or front and rear compensation parameters according to the actual situation.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips2: The car's final position is translated backward by reducing the front and rear compensation numbers, with the positive direction being from the tail to the head of the car.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips3: The effect of putting goods after compensation is shown in the right figure.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips4: Taking the direction from the rear to the front of the vehicle as the positive direction, decreasing the left-right compensation value will result in the final position of the vehicle shifting to the right, and decreasing the front-back compensation value will result in the final position of the vehicle shifting backward.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips5: Assuming that the fork cart puts goods on the shelf with an angle, the angle compensation parameter can be modified.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips6: As shown in the figure below, 1° is off, so -1 should be filled in the angle compensation parameter.
vision.placeShelfLegendTips7: Compensation rule: the larger the value, the counterclockwise rotation of the car.
vision.stackBackFromShelf: The distance from the base point to the front surface of the vehicle when the vehicle is corrected
vision.stackStopFromShelf: The distance from the base point to the surface of the vehicle after parking
vision.stockStackLegendTips1: Assuming that each time the tray is stacked, it is shifted to one direction, you can adjust the left or right or front and rear compensation parameters according to the actual situation.
vision.stockStackLegendTips2: Taking the direction from the rear to the front of the vehicle as the positive direction, decreasing the left-right compensation value will result in the final position of the vehicle shifting to the right, and decreasing the front-back compensation value will result in the final position of the vehicle shifting backward.
vision.stockStackLegendTips3: The stacking effect after compensation is shown in the figure on the right.
vision.stockStackLegendTips4: Assuming that each time a tray is stacked on the cross-carriage, you can modify the angle compensation parameter.
vision.stockStackLegendTips5: As shown in the figure, it is about 1 ° off, so fill in -1 in the angle compensation parameter.
vision.stockStackLegendTips6: The larger the value, the counterclockwise rotation of the car.
vision.storageStopDist: Docking distance in front of the storage location
vision.truckLeaveLegendTips1: Assuming that the vehicle is not centered during the exit process, it is offset to the left by 100mm, and the left compensation coefficient is set to 100, the vehicle will be offset to the right to keep it centered during the exit.
vision.truckLeaveLegendTips2: Assuming that the distance from the tip of the tooth to the front surface of the carriage after exiting is 600, if you want to increase this distance, increase the compensation coefficient.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips1: Taking the left side gap compensation as an example, assuming that the vehicle's outer contour is 200mm away from the left side of the carriage before compensation, and the left side compensation coefficient is set to -100, the vehicle can approach the left side of the carriage wall to 100mm.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips2: The right side compensation coefficient is the same, and adding -100 indicates that it is close to the right side of the carriage wall.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips3: In the loading task, when the fork cart arrives at the storage location in the carriage, assuming that the front end of the fork arm is 100mm away from the storage location before compensation, and the compensation coefficient is set to 100, the vehicle can be moved away from the storage location to 200mm.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips4: Setting a negative compensation coefficient can bring the front end of the fork cart closer to the storage location.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips5: Assuming that the vehicle is not straightened and has an angle deviation, you can modify the angle compensation parameter.
vision.truckLoadPoseLegendTips6: As shown in the figure, the vehicle is offset counterclockwise by 1°, which can be filled in as -1 in the angle compensation parameter, and the vehicle will be corrected clockwise.
vision.truckLoadSidewayLegendTips1: Taking the left side gap compensation as an example, assuming that the left side of the truck body is 50mm away from the side of the goods before compensation, and the left side compensation coefficient is set to -20, the gap between the goods and the truck will be 30.
vision.truckLoadSidewayLegendTips2: The right side compensation coefficient is the same, and setting a negative right side compensation coefficient can bring the goods closer to the right side of the carriage.
vision.truckLoadSidewayLegendTips3: Taking the left side front and back compensation as an example, assuming that the root of the fork arm is 20mm away from the front end of the goods before compensation, and the left side front and back compensation coefficient is set to 20, the distance between the goods and the root of the fork arm can be increased to 40mm.
vision.truckLoadSidewayLegendTips4: Right side front and back compensation coefficient is the same.
vision.truckPublicRotateTips1: Positive compensation, the vehicle rotates counterclockwise, negative compensation, the vehicle rotates clockwise.
vision.truckRunningLeftGap: The gap between the left side of the vehicle and the side of the carriage when driving
vision.truckRunningRightGap: The gap between the right side of the vehicle and the side of the carriage when driving
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips1: In order to ensure that no cross-carriage is in the carriage as much as possible, an observation task needs to be carried out to calculate the truck location deviation.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips2: Taking the left side of the two columns of goods as an example, in order to ensure that the cross-carriage enters as straight as possible during the loading of the left side of the goods, it is necessary to offset the cross-carriage.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips3: The direction of the offset refers to the map coordinate system. As shown in the legend, if it needs to be left offset, it is -300. The same applies to the right side.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips4: Assuming that there is a slope in the scene, it is recommended to set the distance from the tip of the tooth to the bottom of the slope to 400mm-1200mm when the vehicle is at the docking point.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips5: Assuming that there is no slope, the distance from the tip of the tooth to the carriage door when the vehicle is at the docking point is approximately 1000-1500mm.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips6: Assuming that the cross-carriage docking has an angle deviation, the deviation will be automatically calculated during the observation task, and manual fine-tuning is required if necessary.
vision.truckloadObserveLoadLegendTips7: In the figure, the vehicle is offset counterclockwise by 1°, which can be filled in as -1 in the angle compensation parameter, and the vehicle will be corrected clockwise.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips1: In order to ensure that no cross-carriage is in the carriage as much as possible, an observation task needs to be carried out to calculate the truck location deviation.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips2: Taking the left side of the two columns of goods as an example, in order to ensure that the cross-carriage enters as straight as possible during the unloading of the left side of the goods, it is necessary to offset the cross-carriage.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips3: The direction of the offset refers to the map coordinate system. As shown in the legend, if it needs to be left offset, it is -300. The same applies to the right side.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips4: Assuming that there is a slope in the scene, it is recommended to set the distance from the tip of the tooth to the bottom of the slope to 400mm-1200mm when the vehicle is at the docking point.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips5: Assuming that there is no slope, the distance from the tip of the tooth to the carriage door when the vehicle is at the docking point is approximately 1000-1500mm.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips6: Assuming that the cross-carriage docking has an angle deviation, the deviation will be automatically calculated during the observation task, and manual fine-tuning is required if necessary.
vision.truckloadObserveUnloadLegendTips7: In the figure, the vehicle is offset counterclockwise by 1°, which can be filled in as -1 in the angle compensation parameter, and the vehicle will be corrected clockwise.
vision.truckloadSpaceLegendTips1: As an example, when reaching the storage location, assume that the left compensation distance of the truck car body to the left side of the cargo is 10 mm, and the given left compensation coefficient is -10. At this time, the gap between the cargo and the truck car is 0, and the cargo is taut to the left side of the carriage wall.
vision.truckloadSpaceLegendTips2: Right compensation coefficient is also similar, giving a negative right compensation value can make the cart approach the right side of the carriage when putting goods on the right side.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips1: Taking the left side gap compensation as an example, assuming that the vehicle's outer contour is 200mm away from the left side of the carriage before compensation, and the left side compensation coefficient is set to -100, the vehicle can approach the left side of the carriage wall to 100mm.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips2: The right side compensation coefficient is the same, and adding -100 indicates that it is close to the right side of the carriage wall.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips3: Assuming that the front end of the fork arm is 100mm away from the carriage before compensation, and the compensation coefficient is set to 100, the vehicle can be moved away from the carriage to 200mm for docking and next picking move recognition.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips4: Setting a negative compensation coefficient can bring the front end of the fork arm closer to the carriage.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips5: Assuming that the vehicle is not straightened and has an angle deviation, you can modify the angle compensation parameter.
vision.truckloadUnloadPoseLegendTips6: As shown in the figure, the vehicle is offset counterclockwise by 1°, which can be filled in as -1 in the angle compensation parameter, and the vehicle will be corrected clockwise.
vision.truckloadUnloadSidewayLegendTips1: Taking the left side compensation as an example, assuming that the fork arm is 100mm away from the left side of the carriage before compensation, and the left side compensation coefficient is set to -50, the fork arm can approach the left side of the carriage wall to 50mm.
vision.truckloadUnloadSidewayLegendTips2: The right side compensation coefficient is the same, and setting a negative right side compensation coefficient can bring the fork arm closer to the right side of the carriage.
vision.truckloadUnloadSidewayLegendTips3: Assuming that the root of the fork arm is 20mm away from the front end of the goods before compensation, and the left side front and back compensation coefficient is set to 20, the distance between the goods and the root of the fork arm can be increased to 40mm, and the root of the fork arm is away from the front end of the goods. If you reduce the compensation coefficient, this distance will also decrease.
vision.truckloadValidateTips: The height of the goods must not exceed (carriage height - 100), and the left and right gaps of the goods must not be less than 30mm
